abstract: Serum obtained from either normally pregnant women or those with choriocarcinoma was pooled and purified by ammonium acetate/alcohol extraction followed by ionic exchange and gel filtration chromatography. The CG activity was monitored using a double antibody radioimmunoassay utilizing anti hCG both as the labelled ligand and standard. Biological activity was measured by the rat luteal cell radioreceptor assay. Both purified preparations exhibited heterogeneity in terms of the behaviour during ionic exchange chromatography and isoelectric focussing. The Stokes radii were 33A and 33.3A for normal pregnancy and choriocarcinoma hCG respectively. Material from both sources focussed between pH 4.5 and 5.5. Relative to the second international hCG standard the immunological activity of normal pregnancy hCG was 9,100 iu/mg and that of choriocarcinoma CG was 10,970 iu/mg. The corresponding biological potencies were 8,190 iu/mg and 7,569 iu/mg respectively. There was a significant difference between the biological to immunological activity of choriocarcinoma hCG (0.69) when compared with that of normal pregnancy CG (0.90). This was confirmed with a subsequent follow up study when individual serum samples from normal pregnancy were compared with those from choriocarcinoma patients (p = 0.01). It was concluded that in a third world situation this significant difference in the ratio of biological to immunological activity may be a useful method for evaluating treatment of choriocarcinoma patients.
abstract_ja: 絨毛癌患者または正常妊娠の血清をプールし、酢酸アンモニウム/アルコール抽出、イオン交換クロマトグラフィー、ゲル濾過クロマトグラフィーで精製した。CG活性は、標識リガンドおよび標準品として抗ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)を用いた二抗体ラジオイムノアッセイで測定した。生物活性はラット黄体細胞放射受容体アッセイで評価した。両精製標品はイオン交換クロマトグラフィーと等電点電気泳動で不均一性を示した。ストークス半径は、正常妊娠由来のヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)で33Å、絨毛癌由来で33.3Åであった。両者とも pH 4.5〜5.5の間で焦点を結んだ。第2国際hCG標準品に対して、正常妊娠由来の免疫活性は9,100IU/mg、絨毛癌由来は10,970IU/mgであった。対応する生物活性は、それぞれ8,190IU/mgおよび7,569IU/mgであった。絨毛癌由来hCGの生物活性と免疫活性の比(0.69)は、正常妊娠由来(0.90)と比べて有意に低かった。この差は、正常妊娠と絨毛癌患者の個々の血清試料の比較によるフォローアップ研究でも確認された(p=0.01)。第三世界の状況では、この生物活性と免疫活性の比の有意差が、絨毛癌患者の治療評価に有用な方法となりうると結論した。
